narrative.overview:
The signed-in web app is a stock sheet, not a dashboard. The page is a pale green-grey sheet; content sits on white paper with a single hairline; lists run in bands of three rows so the eye keeps its line. Pink appears as a highlighter stroke behind the name of a row that needs the team, and nowhere else as a signal.

Density is working: 13px body, 12px row padding, 20px gutters. Everything that is data is set in DM Mono with tabular numerals. Depth is hairlines and tone; no cards inside cards, no icon tiles, no gradients, no glass.

The palette (green #239e4b, pink #dd6383, derived dark theme) and the login screens are pinned by the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Listagem Zebrada: green band on rows 1-3, plain on 4-6, repeating.
Pink highlighter behind a name, never pink text.
State in form as well as hue: full bar, dashed, struck, doubled.
One sans family plus mono for data; no eyebrows in the interior.
Rail of index tabs that opens over the page without pushing it.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Pink is a stroke behind a name, on the lower 40% of the line, for a row that needs the team. It is never a text colour and never a fill for a button.

rules.name: The Deep Green Rule
rules.body: Solid green behind white text uses #147a37, not #239e4b.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Surfaces, text, hairlines, band and status inks follow --color-* variables; green and pink brand values stay fixed in both themes.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number a person might compare is DM Mono with tabular numerals, and money goes through utils/money.js (pt-BR).

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second sans, no serif inside the signed-in app.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: A sheet is never nested inside a sheet.

dos: Do band lists in threes with --color-band, and put figures in DM Mono tabular.
Do show stock state as shape plus label plus ink, never hue alone.
Do use #147a37 behind white text; keep the focus ring 2px #239e4b.
Do keep copy in pt-BR and the same words as the phone app.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animation (rise, page-in, row-in, flap, toggle).
Do show empty states plainly; stock starts being entered this week.
donts: Don't colour text pink, or fill a button with pink.
Don't nest sheets, add icon tiles, gradients (the highlighter wash and stock-out strike are the only ones), or glass.
Don't put Playfair Display or a second sans in the interior.
Don't build the generic left menu, four KPI cards and plain white table.
Don't invent data the API lacks; hide the control instead.
